parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name that you want to query. You can specify multiple domain names. Separate them with commas (,). You can specify up to 500 domain names. If you specify multiple domain names, the data is aggregated. If you leave this parameter empty, the aggregated data for all your accelerated domain names is returned.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity for the query, in seconds.

Valid values are 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). The supported value depends on the maximum time span of a single query. For more information, see the table of supported time granularities in this topic.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description: The English name of the carrier. Call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to obtain the name. If you do not set this parameter, data for all carriers is returned.

parameters.name: Layer
parameters.description: The layer to query. Valid values: \`network\` (IPv4 and IPv6), \`application\` (HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC), or \`all\`. The default value is \`all\`.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description: The English name of the region. Call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to obtain the name. If you do not set this parameter, data for all regions is returned.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The minimum time granularity is 5 minutes. If you do not set this parameter, data in the last 24 hours is returned.
